## Progress

- SMS behind `ISmsGateway`: local sink to the mail sink (Development) and a gateway that fails closed (visible as failed) until the provider is chosen (Q-03, MDV-P1-045)
- SMS uses only registered templates: the text must match a catalogue template (`{#var#}` slots, 30 characters each) and in India have its DLT template id from config (`Notifications:Sms:DltTemplateIds`, keys like `Confirmation.en`) and a sender (`Notifications:Sms:Senders` per tenant or `DefaultSender`); otherwise it is Failed at once and never handed to a provider; messages hold no clinical details
- Delivery receipts: `POST /v1/notifications/receipts` (public, HMAC-SHA256 of the body with `Notifications:ReceiptSecret`, refused when unset), applied inside the tenant named by the reference; duplicate and out-of-order receipts are ignored; failures visible to reception (see MDV-P1-032)
- Left: the SMS provider adapter and its own receipt format (Q-03); DLT sender and template registration with the operator (MDV-P1-045, a person task: put the ids in config); delivery-rate dashboard screen (the API returns per-channel counts and every failure; MDV-P1-041); SMS invitations in onboarding step 6

## Description

SMS adapter (Azure Communication Services where supported, otherwise a DLT-registered aggregator) behind the Notifications interface. India messages use the registered DLT template IDs and sender; UAE uses its approved sender. Delivery receipts update NOTIFICATION_ATTEMPT. Reminder delivery rate is computed per clinic.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** SMS uses only registered templates; a message not matching a registered template is not sent (validation test).
- [ ] **AC2.** Delivery receipts are processed (webhook verified/authenticated) and update status; failures are visible to reception.
- [ ] **AC3.** Delivery rate dashboard shows ≥ 98 % delivered during the pilot or lists every failure with reason (exit gate 4).
- [ ] **AC4.** Messages contain no clinical details; sender name is the clinic's.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
